# auth

Types from PocketBase's Go package `auth`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [auth](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/auth).

|---|---|---|

| `fetchAuthUser()` | <code>(token: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/oauth2#oauth2token">oauth2.Token</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/auth#authauthuser">AuthUser</a>)</code> | FetchAuthUser is similar to FetchRawUserInfo, but normalizes and marshalizes the user api response into a standardized AuthUser struct. |

## auth.AuthUser
